source_evidence: Exact player 'Follow' accepts the first warder's offered introduction to fellow warder, following him from receiving hall through east door and established20ft passage with6ft rise into unoccupied20x30 raised gallery. Fenar/Cirren follow voluntarily; receiving two skeletons remain at posts under first warder's new instruction, no attack. First warder claims V first of House to walk here in a very long time, expressing provisional belief, not independent lineage proof. Visible daylight from exterior ledge opening, ancient carved charter panel with protection/refuge/upkeep and limits on demanding service without protection, recognizable but not yet transcribed or fully decoded; three mechanical control levers and float gauge at north wall remain untouched. Cirren notes relevance of charter to V's newly proposed duty; no copies, bearing calculation or full translation yet. Warder leads to top of stairs toward lower chamber, party at southern gallery edge near(45,40), no descent into lower room or opening of its closed northern door(45,60). First warder calls down and speaks in V's favor, reporting claimant and provisional renewed protection duty. The second warder answers audibly from beyond door, challenges first warder's right to change ancient orders and asks for claimant's own explanation. Does not see party through door or know V's identity, no assent, attack, initiative, reinforcement or movement into party's space. First warder offers support, no automatic second allegiance. Day331~16:38. No roll: ordinary following and voluntary initial dialogue, not adjudicating second's contested allegiance. No new cost, resource, item, evidence custody or title change.
